limitations: All historical periods and earlier related research were inspected. This is exploratory, not a fresh holdout.
Ten L3 weeks represent only two L3 crisis clusters; no severity significance claim is permitted.
Overlapping starts, horizon-spaced starts and calendar blocks are descriptive counts, not independent observations.

Macro and canonical z inputs use the last stored monthly snapshot, at most 62 days old; this can lag weekly releases and current market prices. Missing pre-2011 dashboard momentum is not reconstructed with revisions.
Canonical price/value z and the separate exploratory one-year price z have different coverage and meanings.
Top-decile labels and local best-entry examples are selected after outcomes; antecedents are hypotheses, not live trading rules.
Returns are standalone net event outcomes, not continuous portfolio CAGR. MAE uses daily closes and excludes intraday losses.
Daily sources differ from older monthly snapshots at some historical dates; per-asset reconciliation status remains visible.
